fee_notes: Royalty is tiered based on annual Gross Revenues: 6% on first $1,000,000; 5.5% on $1,000,000.01–$2,000,000; 5.0% on $2,000,000.01–$5,000,000; 4.5% on $5,000,000.01–$10,000,000; 4.25% on $10,000,000.01–$20,000,000; 4.0% on $20,000,000.01–$30,000,000; 3.75% on $30,000,000.01 and above. Minimum Annual Royalty is $60,000 (prorated for partial years), equivalent to $5,000/month. Each tier rate applies only to the revenue increment within that tier; rates reset January 1 each year. If franchisee fails to report accurately/timely or fails to pay, royalty reverts to flat 6% for remainder of term. National Marketing and Technology Fund is also tiered: 2% on first $2,000,000; 1.875% on $2,000,000.01–$5,000,000; 1.750% on $5,000,000.01–$10,000,000; 1.625% on $10,000,000.01–$30,000,000; 1.50% on $30,000,000.01 and above. Marketing/tech fund also resets annually; failure to report/pay triggers flat 2%. No separate standalone technology fee disclosed — technology is bundled into the National Marketing and Technology Fund. Marketing and tech fees are combined into one fund. Additional fees include: LPT training $4,998/person (first person covered by initial franchise fee); Sales Advisor training $98/person; Staff Member training $298/person; Conference Fee (varies); GG Magazine advertisement $3,025/year (1 full-page property ad required); Transfer Fee $2,500 (or $10,000+ for securities offering); Renewal Fee 50% of Initial Franchise Fee; Development Services Designation $2,500–$6,000/year (optional); Commercial Designation $5,000–$6,000/year (optional); Development Services Consulting Fee 8%–10% of Gross Revenues from applicable project (optional); Internal Commissions/Referral Fee negotiated between franchisees.
